subject: pri-info-td
title: PRI.VT.TD.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in MP(I)-31 — the section identifying black political activism's twelfth-hour need to adopt 'the vibrational and actual tenets of western ideology' as a clarifying real-reality move. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the fact that, in the twelfth hour, the composite-reality position of black political activism would have to adopt the vibrational and actual tenets of western ideology cannot be viewed lightly. Because the realness of this adaptation would clarify the real "reality" position of this phenomenon — and this is true on every level.' The crossing diagrams that adaptation structurally: the title crosses PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies) with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance — the working continuance the western-ideology-adoption produces). In the drawing the subject label, with the subject-arrow, reads (C)PRI-INFO-TD (the concept of principle information tendencies); its main line runs up-right to PROG-CONT. ACC-F (accelerated functionalism) branches left from the main line, with (R)MTH (the reality of methodology) rising from ACC-F's line and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) dropping from it, and INFO-DY (information dynamics) branching from VT-DY's line. COS-P (cosmic particulars) branches down-right from the main line, with C-CONT (composite continuance) dropping from COS-P's line, IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) branching from C-CONT's line, IST-F (isolated focus) from IF-ST-DY's line, and INFO-TRNS (information transference) from IST-F's line.
